description: This file defines an interface IBlobContainerFactory for creating blob container clients and a default implementation DefaultBlobContainerFactory that manages Azure Blob Storage containers, including initialization and retrieval based on grain IDs.

classes.name: DefaultBlobContainerFactory
classes.description: A default implementation of IBlobContainerFactory that manages a single container using provided options.

methods.name: GetBlobContainerClient
methods.description: Returns the BlobContainerClient associated with the specified grain ID.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the container client asynchronously using the provided BlobServiceClient.
